about.intro: This is a fan-made launcher built with one goal in mind: to make playing Deadly Premonition: The Director's Cut as comfortable as possible. One click of the LAUNCH button instead of an hour-long ritual with DPfix, 4GB Patch, DXVK, and registry tweaks. The launcher automatically downloads and installs all required components.
about.dpfixDesc: Graphics fix — custom resolutions, anti-aliasing, shadows, SSAO, UI corrections.
about.fourGbDesc: Removes the 2 GB RAM ceiling for the 32-bit game process.
about.dxvkDesc: Vulkan renderer for Direct3D 9 — stability, performance, modern rendering instead of legacy DirectX calls.

reset.title: Reset everything
reset.help: Wipes saved settings and the event log. The launcher restarts and shows first-run setup again. Game files and save backups are not touched.
reset.confirmBody: Launcher settings and the event log will be deleted, then the launcher will restart and run first-run setup again. Game files and save backups stay intact.
dpcFixes.title: DPC Fixes
skipIntro.title: Skip Intro Videos
skipIntro.help: Patches a single byte in DeadlyPremonition.exe (0x243333) so the game skips its startup logo videos. A .bak is created before the write — you can revert any time.
skipIntro.label: Skip intro videos
skipIntro.confirmBody: The launcher will flip one byte in DeadlyPremonition.exe (0x243333: B3 → 00). A .bak with the original is saved alongside — you can revert with the same toggle.
skipIntro.revertBody: Restore the original DeadlyPremonition.exe byte (0x243333: 00 → B3) and bring the startup videos back?
skipIntro.noExe: Set the path to DeadlyPremonition.exe in General first.
fpsCap.title: FPS Cap 60
fpsCap.help: The DPC engine was designed for fixed 30/60 FPS — at higher framerates physics and scripts break. The launcher writes dxvk.maxFrameRate = 60 to dxvk.conf (universal for NVIDIA/AMD/Intel since we ship DXVK). If that doesn't take effect, the button below opens your GPU's control panel for a manual cap.
fpsCap.label: Cap FPS at 60
fpsCap.tipAfterApply: Wrote dxvk.maxFrameRate = 60 to dxvk.conf. Restart the game.
fpsCap.gpuOpenedHint: {vendor} panel opened. Find DeadlyPremonition.exe → set Max Frame Rate = 60.
dxvkCache.label: DXVK Shader Cache
dxvkCache.help: On modern drivers DXVK 2.x delegates shader caching to the GPU driver (NVIDIA DXCache / AMD DxCache). First-encounter stutter is normal JIT compilation; subsequent runs hit cache and play smooth. The dp.dxvk-cache file in the game folder is optional.
dxvkCache.noteDriverOnly: Shader cache lives at the driver level. Clear via NVIDIA Control Panel → 3D Settings → Restore Defaults.
dxvkCache.cleanBody: Delete all *.dxvk-cache files in the game folder. Next launch will recompile shaders (brief stutter).
codecFix.title: Cutscene Codec Fix
codecFix.help: K-Lite / LAV Filters intercept .wmv decoding and can crash the game on Win11 + RTX hardware during cutscenes. The launcher temporarily lowers LAV's DirectShow merit so Microsoft's native decoders win the filter graph race. Changes apply ONLY during a game session: once DeadlyPremonition.exe exits, the original values are restored automatically. Requires admin rights.
codecFix.label: Native codec priority (session-scoped)
codecFix.confirmBody: Spawn a background watcher that lowers LAV merits now, waits for DeadlyPremonition.exe to start, then waits for it to exit and automatically reverts all changes. If the watcher dies unexpectedly, a backup in %APPDATA%\dp1-launcher lets you restore manually.
codecFix.revertBody: Stop the watcher now? It will restore the original LAV merits and exit.
codecFix.adminBody: Codec fix writes to HKLM in the registry — the launcher must run elevated. Restart with UAC prompt?
codecFix.noLav: LAV Filters not found in registry. K-Lite is not installed — codec fix is not needed.
cursorHide.title: Hide Cursor In-Game
cursorHide.help: Spawns a background watcher that hides the mouse cursor whenever DeadlyPremonition.exe is the foreground window. On Alt-Tab the cursor returns; back in-game it hides again. Automatically terminates with the game.
cursorHide.label: Hide cursor in-game
captureCursor.label: DPfix: capture cursor
captureCursor.help: Alternative cursor fix via DPfix (D3D9-wrapper level). Writes CaptureCursor 1 into DPfix.ini. Works only if DPfix is actually active (your d3d9.dll = DPfix proxy). Can be enabled together with the watcher — they don't conflict.
captureCursor.noIni: DPfix.ini not found in game directory.
captureCursor.activeHint: Restart the game so DPfix picks up the change.
toast.sessionWarning: DP.exe has been running ~{hours}+ hours. Consider restarting the game to avoid an audio-pool crash (see docs/AUDIO_POOL_LEAK.md).
map.title: INTERACTIVE GREENVALE MAP
map.help: Click and drag to pan. Scroll wheel to zoom. Press <kbd>R</kbd> to reset view.
map.error: Failed to load map. Check your internet connection.
dxvkRevert.title: DXVK
dxvkRevert.help: If DXVK causes problems, fully revert it: the launcher restores the original d3d9.dll in the game folder from .bak and deletes C:\Windows\SysWOW64\d9vk.dll. Administrator rights are required to remove the system DLL.
dxvkRevert.confirmBody: The launcher will undo every step of the DXVK patch in reverse order: restore d3d9.dll from .bak in the game folder and delete C:\Windows\SysWOW64\d9vk.dll. Save backups and your saves are not touched.
dxvkRevert.noGame: Set the game path in General first.
dxvkRevert.needAdmin: Administrator rights required to revert DXVK.
dxvkToggle.label: Use DXVK (Vulkan wrapper)
dxvkToggle.help: DXVK translates D3D9 to Vulkan — helps on old drivers, but on RTX 40/50 + Win11 it adds 2-3× to load times due to driver-level pipeline JIT compile. Turn off for fast startup via native D3D9. DPfix patches (widescreen, FOV, 4GB) stay active in both modes.
dxvkToggle.enableBody: Launcher will: (1) copy d3d9.dll from _dxvk-cache to C:\Windows\SysWOW64\d9vk.dll; (2) hex-patch the game's d3d9.dll to forward into d9vk.dll. First game launch after this will be slow (Vulkan pipeline JIT compile); subsequent launches faster thanks to driver cache.
dxvkToggle.disableBody: Launcher will: (1) restore game d3d9.dll from .bak (or hex-undo); (2) delete C:\Windows\SysWOW64\d9vk.dll. Game will use native d3d9.dll from System32 — much faster loading on RTX 40/50.
dxvkToggle.adminBody: Toggling DXVK writes/deletes a file under C:\Windows\SysWOW64 — launcher must run elevated. Restart with UAC prompt?

fr.presetDpfixDxvkDesc: Vulkan renderer + DPfix widescreen/FOV/HUD fixes. Most stable for most systems, but first launch is slower (DXVK compiles shader cache).
fr.presetDxvkOnlyDesc: Vulkan renderer without DPfix wrapper. Faster after first launch. No widescreen/FOV fixes, but all DPfix exe patches (4GB etc.) stay.
fr.presetDpfixOnlyDesc: DPfix with native d3d9 from System32. Minimal dependencies. Best if DXVK causes problems or your GPU is old without Vulkan support.
fr.extra4gbDesc: Removes the 2 GB memory limit for DP.exe. Recommended if you have more than 4 GB of system RAM.
presetsTab.title: Render Preset
presetsTab.help: Switch between the three render configurations without re-running the wizard. All presets keep the DPfix hex patches inside DP.exe (widescreen / FOV / 4GB) — only the D3D9 chain changes: via DXVK (Vulkan), via native D3D9, or both.
presetsTab.confirmBody: Launcher will reconfigure the d3d9.dll chain accordingly. DXVK presets need admin rights (write to SysWOW64).
stability.heroHelp: A composite mode for crashes around cutscenes / loading / building transitions and for save safety. This is NOT an audio-pool patch — it targets the bug classes the community reports most often (transition state, cutscene boundaries, codec/PhysX runtime).
stability.noGame: Set game path in General first.
stability.confirmApplyBody: Launcher will: (1) enable crash dump collection via HKCU (no admin), (2) set DXVK FPS cap = 60 in dxvk.conf, (3) apply DPfix borderless/windowed-safe defaults (with backup as .stability-mode.bak). DP.exe is NOT modified.
stability.confirmRevertBody: Restore previous DPfix.ini / dxvk.conf state and remove crash-dump registry keys (only those added by this mode).
crashdump.title: Crash Dump Helper
crashdump.help: Configures Windows Error Reporting LocalDumps for DP.exe under HKCU (no admin required). Dumps will be saved to %LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps\.
media.title: Media / Cutscene Compatibility
media.help: Scans for codec packs (LAV, K-Lite, MPC-HC, Shark007, ffdshow) that may cause WMV cutscene freezes/black screens. Detection only — never modifies codecs automatically.
media.clean: No codec packs / LAV modules detected
media.warnText: Codec packs detected — may interfere with WMV cutscenes
physx.title: Legacy PhysX Check
physx.help: Checks if NVIDIA PhysX legacy runtime (used by DP1 for physics) is installed. The Steam Deck reference setup uses PhysX 9.13.0725.
physx.missing: NVIDIA PhysX legacy runtime not detected — game may not start
xidi.title: Controller Compatibility (Xidi)
xidi.help: Xidi is a DirectInput-to-XInput wrapper for controller compatibility (Xbox/PlayStation/Steam Deck). Use only if you have controller problems — this is not a crash fix and not needed for most users.
xidi.installedFull: Xidi appears to be installed (Xidi.ini found)
xidi.notInstalled: Xidi is not installed in game folder
diagExport.title: Diagnostic Package Export
diagExport.help: Export a zip archive of launcher state + check results + game logs. No save files, no crash dumps (which can be large) — those must be opt-in. Useful when sending a crash report.
risky.title: Known Risky Areas
risky.intro: Community-reported scenes where crashes happen more often. Not guaranteed — just patterns.
risky.ep1ch6Desc: Community Center area, quest timeframe transitions
risky.tips: Recommended: Recommended Stability Mode • Save Backup • do not overwrite a single save near transitions • if a crash repeats, try smoking/sleeping in-game to advance past the broken state.
gpuCompat.title: GPU Driver Compatibility
gpuCompat.help: Older AMD/Intel D3D9 drivers can deadlock on certain game scenes (confirmed via Ch.3 hospital hang dump). If you get random hangs not at loading screens but mid-gameplay — DXVK most likely fixes it.
gpuCompat.recommendDxvk: Older AMD/Intel GPU detected. If you get random in-game hangs, switching to DXVK (Vulkan) is the most reliable fix — it bypasses the legacy D3D9 driver path entirely.
nanGuard.title: ⚠ Experimental: NaN Hang Guard
nanGuard.help: Experimental. Modifies DP.exe on disk (2 bytes, with sidecar JSON for revert). Replaces an internal infinite-loop assert at VA 0x00409EA6 with two NOPs so NaN float input returns 0.0f instead of hanging the thread. Pattern-scanned and SHA-256-verified — refuses if your DP.exe doesn't match. Use only if you experience random AppHang freezes during Ch.3 / loading transitions.
nanGuard.noteApplied: Patch is currently applied. Game returns 0.0f fallback instead of hanging on NaN.
nanGuard.noteFound: Ready to apply. Sidecar JSON stores revert metadata (no full backup needed).
nanGuard.noteNoPattern: Pattern not found — your DP.exe is a different build (GOG / cracked / non-Steam?). Patch is unsupported.
nanGuard.noteAmbiguous: Multiple matches — refusing to patch (unexpected binary layout).
nanGuard.noteJustApplied: Patch applied. Launch the game and test Ch.3 / loading transitions.
nanGuard.noteJustReverted: Patch reverted. DP.exe is back to original bytes.
nanGuard.confirmApplyBody: Modifies DP.exe on disk: 2 bytes at file offset 0x92A6 (VA 0x00409EA6). A sidecar JSON (.nanguard.json) stores revert metadata. After patch, the game returns 0.0f fallback instead of hanging when an internal float helper receives NaN. Fully reversible at any time. EXPERIMENTAL — use only if you experience hangs.
nanGuard.confirmRevertBody: Restores original 2 bytes (EB FE) at the patch site and removes the sidecar JSON.
admin.confirmBody: DPfix + DXVK preset writes a DLL to C:\Windows\SysWOW64, which requires Administrator. Click OK to relaunch the launcher elevated (UAC prompt) and continue. Cancel to fall back to the "DXVK only" preset instead, which writes only into the game folder (no admin).
admin.relaunchFailed: Failed to relaunch elevated. Right-click the launcher icon and pick "Run as administrator" manually.
